info.title: Generic HTTP target (OpenFn common adaptor http namespace)
info.description: @openfn/language-common is the shared helper library every adaptor builds on. Its only network surface is the http namespace: http.request(method, url, options), http.get(url) and http.post(url, data) call any absolute URL (or a path with options.baseUrl), with auth set by the job through headers or http.options().basic()/bearer()/oauth(). This document models that surface as collection- and item-level path templates carrying arbitrary JSON. The 33 public state helpers in ast.json (fn, each, field, merge, cursor, ...) run in-process and make no request; they are enumerated in info.x-openfn-local-operations.

servers.description: Origin of the absolute URL (or options.baseUrl) the job passes.

tags.name: Resources
tags.description: Any path on any host, via the http namespace.

get.summary: GET a collection path of the target API
get.description: GET {baseUrl}/{resource} - made by http.get(url) or http.request("GET", url). The path is any path the job passes; {resource}/{id} stand for its segments (OpenAPI cannot express a multi-segment wildcard). Response bodies are parsed as JSON when the server says so (parseAs), otherwise text or a stream.

default.description: Error from the target API; the adaptor throws on 4xx/5xx unless options.errors suppresses it.
